To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a combined heavy resistance training with high intensity running speed training program is more efficient in increasing the power performance of young male soccer players than the conventional resistance and speed training programs performed in separate training sessions.
the combined strength and speed training program is more beneficial than the conventional resistance program in terms of power performance of soccer player.

a combination of strength and speed training performed in the same session, is more effective than a conventional strength training program, regarding the power and speed performance of soccer players.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of combined heavy resistance and speed training performed in the same session on running velocity, vertical jump and strength of male soccer players.
the effects of a combined high intensity strength and speed training program performed at the same training sessions on strength, running speed, and jumping ability.
the effects of combined resistance and speed program on the strength and power performance of soccer athletes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
combined resistance and speed program provides better power results than the conventional training.
the COM group improved their 1RMs, running speed, and vertical jump performance, and the STR group improved their 10RMs and 1RMs.
the COM group performed better than the STR group in the 30m dash test, and better than the CON group in the 1RM and jump test.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
combining strength and running speed training is a more effective method for the development of explosive power of soccer players than performing the strength training alone.
the COM training program is a more effective method than the STR training program for improving strength, speed, and vertical jump performance in soccer players.
combining resistance training and running speed training in the same training sessions is a more effective method for improving the strength, running and jumping ability of soccer players.
The main takeaway from our work is that
combining heavy resistance and running training is an efficient training method that can be applied to the soccer training.
the combined resistance training with running speed training provides a better effect than resistance training alone.
a combined strength-speed training program performed in one training session is more effective than the conventional strength training in terms of improving power performance in soccer players.
